subject: RE: Redwood POC proposal & success criteria - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Alvarez <elena@regenhealth.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <cto@regenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood POC proposal & success criteria - next steps

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for taking the time to meet today — really enjoyed learning more about RegenHealth's roadmap and where inference fits into your clinical summarization pipeline. Per our call, here's a concise recap and proposed plan for a short POC so your team can validate latency, cost, and quality trade-offs: 

Summary of goals (from our discussion):
- Validate generation quality on anonymized discharge summaries (edge cases & hallucination rate)
- Confirm 95th-percentile latency under 300ms for 1-2 concurrent editors
- Understand per-request token cost at target throughput (1k daily active users)

Proposed POC plan (3 weeks):
1) Kickoff & access (Week 0): permissions, sample dataset ingestion, and test account setup.
2) Baseline run (Week 1): run your set of 50 eval prompts, measure latency/cost/quality.
3) Optimization & tuning (Week 2): apply batching, KV-prefix caching, and quantization recommendations from Redwood.
4) Final readout (Week 3): 30–45 minute exec readout to present results and a recommended next step.

Success criteria (please confirm):
- Quality: Fewer than 5% critical hallucinations on the evaluation prompt set.
- Latency: 95th percentile tokens < 300ms for typical document lengths (up to 1k tokens).
- Cost: Per-request cost within 20% of the target range we discussed (TBD if you want exact numbers).

Owners / roles:
- RegenHealth: Elena (primary contact), Miguel (technical exec sponsor)
- Redwood: Marissa (CS), Marcus (SE) for infra & config, Neha (security/compliance) for questionnaire & access controls

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (high-level POC plan & checklist).

Immediate next steps:
- Can you confirm the sample dataset availability and whether a non-production S3 bucket is available for ingestion?
- Can you confirm target week for kickoff (we're currently available starting Nov 16)?
- If you prefer, I can share a short DocuSign for the POC terms (data use + limited trial agreement).

If that all looks good I can send the kickoff invite and loop in Marcus + Neha.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the clear plan — this aligns well with what we want to validate. A few quick clarifications before we lock dates: 
- Cost: can you give a rough estimate for a 3-week POC (infra + token estimate)? We need to budget internally.
- Data retention: what are Redwood's default logs/retention and can that be disabled for the trial?
- Evaluation metrics: we'll share our labeled eval set (50 prompts) but would like Redwood to run both automated quality metrics and a short human review for edge cases.

We can likely do the kickoff the week of Nov 16. For the final readout, can we target the week of Nov 23 (ideally Nov 24 for an exec slot)? Miguel would like to join the final readout.

Also — please send over your security contact so we can route a short questionnaire.

Thanks,
Elena
VP Product\RegenHealth
elena@regenhealth.com

Marcus / Neha — looping you in to kick off the RegenHealth POC. Elena confirmed interest and the week-of-Nov-16 kickoff window. Key asks below and owner suggestions: 

Regen asks:
- Cost estimate for a 3-week POC (infra config + expected token volume) — owner: Marcus
- Data retention controls and security questionnaire responses — owner: Neha
- Setup: non-prod test account creation & sample ingestion — owner: Marcus + marissa to coordinate schedule

Attachments: POC checklist.xlsx (I put a preliminary list of test items and rollout tasks).

I'll draft the kickoff invite for Nov 17 at 10am PT pending Marcus's timing and Elena's confirmation.

Thanks team — cc'ing Elena so she's aware of internal owners.

Marissa
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: FW: Redwood POC proposal & success criteria - planning (internal)

Marissa / Neha — thanks for the heads up. Proposed POC config and rough cost: 

POC config (recommended)
- Model: rdx-13b-ft (quantized q4f16) for a balance of quality/latency
- Instance: 1x A10G equivalent (dedicated pool) for baseline; we can add a second to meet latency SLOs for parallel editors
- Batch settings: dynamic prefix batching with per-user session affinity

Estimated cost for 3-week POC (infra + tokens): ~$4,200 (this includes reserved GPU pool for the 3 weeks + an estimated token spend for 50 eval prompts and a small live test cohort). I can break this down line-by-line if you want (attached infra-estimate.csv).

Monitoring / dashboards: I'll prepare a short Grafana view for latency and token cost; link to a sample dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dashboard/poc-sample (internal).

I'll be available for the kickoff; I suggest we include a 30-minute deep technical sync during Week 1 for ingestion and eval harness.

--
Marcus Lin

Draft agenda: 
- 5 min: quick context & POC scope reminder
- 15 min: results (quality, latency, cost)
- 10 min: recommendations & optional configuration paths
- 10 min: Q&A + decision (go/no-go + next commercial step)

Request from RegenHealth for the readout: please confirm who will attend and whether a formal go/no-go decision maker (CEO/Head of Product/Procurement) will be present. We'll prepare a short costed term sheet and can circulate a one-page decision memo in advance.

Attachments: final-readout-deck.pdf (skeleton deck). Also happy to start a DocuSign for a term sheet if you want: https://www.docusign.com/reef/placeholder-term-sheet

If Nov 24 10:00 AM PT works, I'll send the formal invite and include our exec/SE.

Thanks,
Marissa
